from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its key identifying attributes."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action or case type specified in the document (e.g., '所有权纠纷', '劳动争议')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
